ModMetaData.name: IsoRimZ
ModMetaData.author: Lin
ModMetaData.description:
Build upward. Upper floors, stairs and tall mountains for IsoRim Waylith.
- Upper floors of wood, stone or metal; pawns live, work and fight on every floor. - Stairs, ladders and elevators; hold Shift and scroll to switch floors. - Raiders climb, mine up and blast through floors. - Tall mountains and multi-deck gravships. - Once a save has used IsoRimZ, removing the mod breaks that save.
往上盖。给 IsoRim Waylith 加上楼层、楼梯和高山。
- 用木头、石头或金属盖楼层；小人在每一层生活、干活、打仗。 - 楼梯、梯子和电梯；按住 Shift 滚动鼠标滚轮切换楼层。 - 敌人会爬上来、挖进山里、炸穿楼板。 - 高山和多层飞船。 - 存档一旦用过 IsoRimZ，去掉这个 mod 就会坏档。
